==Gameplay Notes==
{{CharacterUpdateHistory|2025-01-10}}

===Gilded Heaven Strike===
*The second linked skill activated via {{status|Twin Tiger Fury|t=i}} is considered an auto-activated skill.
**Effects that track skill usage (e.g., {{ClassIcon|Lumberjack|size=x18px}}[[Lumberjack]]'s {{status|Woodcutter's Song}}) do not count the auto-activated linked skill.
**Effects that follow the usage of a skill (e.g., {{itm|Lobelia}}'s {{status|Thunderbolt of Disaster}}) occur after only the first linked skill.

===Jinx of the Tiger===
*Randomly inflicts additional effects from the following:<ref name="GameWith">GameWith, Cidala. https://グランブルーファンタジー.gamewith.jp/article/show/311656</ref>
**{{Status|Water ATK Lowered|t=180s|a=20%|acc=100%}}
**{{Status|Earth DEF Down|t=180s|a=20%|acc=100%}}
**{{Status|Debuff Resistance Lowered|t=180s|a=20%|acc=100%}}
**{{Status|Blinded 3|t=3T|a=60%|acc=100%}}
**{{Status|Charmed|t=180s|a=20%|acc=100%}}
*The number of additional effects inflicted increases with the foe's {{Status|Tiger Tape|s=p}} lvl.
**At lvl 5, all additional effects are inflicted.

===Tiger's Prosperity===
*Randomly grants additional effects from the following:<ref name="GameWith" />
**{{Status|Dispel Cancel|t=i|n=1}}
**{{Status|Mirror Image|t=i|n=1}}
**{{Status|Shield|t=i|a=3000}}
**{{Status|C.A. Reactivation (1 time)|t=i}}
**{{Status|Charge Bar|a=30%}}
*The number of additional effects granted increases with the foe's {{Status|Tiger Tape|s=p}} lvl.
**At lvl 5, all additional effects are granted.

===Twin Tiger Feng Shui===
{{AssassinBuff|{{status|ATK Sharply Boosted|t=1T|a=50%|m=ass}}}}

=== High of the Tiger ===
* {{Status|High of the Tiger|t=i}} grants the following effects:<ref name="GameWith" />
** 20% N.A. DMG Amplified
** 20% Skill DMG Amplified
** 2-hit [[Flurry]] effect
** '''After normal attacks:''' Deal 800% Earth damage to the foe (Damage cap: ~830,000)

===Queen of Tigers===
{{PermanentDebuffStacking|1={{status|Tiger Tape|t=i|s=p}}|ref=<ref name="GameWith" />}}
* At level 90, {{Status|Tiger Tape+}} also supplements damage taken by foes affected by the debuff.
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;"

*In a 4-man party with default hostility, the probability that Cidala gets targeted is ~50%.

===Reversal of Fortune===
*{{CharacterSupportSkill|Cidala|2}} activates ''after'' turn-progressing effects such as {{status|Time Warp}} and {{itm|Clarisse (Valentine)}}'s {{CharacterSupportSkill|page=Clarisse_(Valentine)|no=2}}.
*In multi-wave battles, this support skill will activate if Cidala does not get to attack before progressing to the next wave.
*In [[Battle System 2.0]], [[Battle System 2.0#Guarding|Guarding]] for a turn will activate this support skill.

=== Belling the Silver Tiger ===
* {{CharacterSupportSkill|Cidala|3}} only triggers when Earth MC uses buff skills ([[Skill Color|yellow border]]). 
** The skill does not have to actually buff or target {{PAGENAME}}.
**Skills with other border colors do not trigger this support skill, even if they provide a buff.
**Auto-activated skills and 0-turn cooldown skills do not trigger this support skill.

=== Belling the Gold Tiger ===
* {{CharacterSupportSkill|Cidala|4}} only triggers when Earth MC uses damage skills ([[Skill Color|red border]]). 
** The skill does not have to actually deal damage.
**Skills with other border colors do not trigger this support skill, even if they deal damage.
**Auto-activated skills and 0-turn cooldown skills do not trigger this support skill.

===Extended Mastery Support Skill===
*{{verify|1% boost to triple attack rate per debuff.}}
**Each rank increases the maximum triple attack rate boost, but not the boost per debuff.
